campaign.brief: PetPawsPhere — UAE's pet matching, care & verified breeder platform for pet owners, breeders, and vet clinics. AI-powered dog and cat breed detection, smart matching for pets, verified breeders with MOCCAE documents, pet care reminders, bilingual Arabic-first pet care app. Free pet matching, Plus 29 AED/mo, Breeder Pro 149 AED/mo.
campaign.image_prompt:
Premium Pet advertisement in vertical 3:4 format.
Product @img1: Preserve the exact product shape, deep red, kraft finish, bag, clean typography, label placement, proportions, and packaging identity exactly. Do not change the product branding, text layout, color, bag closure, structure, or proportions.
The background must complement the product color — kraft paper, warm brown, natural green, bright blue, fresh tone, slobber, water bowl splash, or kitchen floor, dog bed, outdoor grass.
COMPOSITION: Vertical 3:4, centered, close-up or hero foreground, premium ad framing.
LIGHTING: natural window light, warm kitchen.
QUALITY: Photorealistic, sharp focus, luxury campaign finish, commercial polish.
The overall feel is editorial, premium, pet campaign.
campaign.video_prompt:
12s UGC style review video, filmed on smartphone, natural window light, handheld selfie angle.
Product @img1: Preserve the exact product shape, deep red, kraft finish, bag, clean typography, label placement, proportions, and packaging identity exactly. Do not change the product branding, text layout, color, bag closure, structure, or proportions.
Jump cut — hook: show the product. Jump cut — demo: use it. Jump cut — result: react. Final shot — verdict.
CAMERA: Handheld selfie angle, each jump cut slightly different angle.
LIGHTING: natural window light, warm kitchen.
AUDIO: Phone mic, room ambience, no music.
The product from @(img1) must remain visually unchanged in every shot. Maintain product design and label details throughout.
The overall feel is trustworthy, relatable, real.
